display.purpose: The one page title (h1) per view.

title.purpose: Dialog, sheet and popover titles; page section headings (h2).

section.purpose: A section inside a dialog or page (h3); at regular weight, one-line statements.

body.purpose: Running text, field values, buttons, tabs, chips, garment names.

eyebrow.purpose: Tracked caps label voice: field labels, row keys, filter chips, the top view switch. Never above a heading.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Resting chips and small floating labels.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, active filter pill, primary button at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Hover lift of cards and buttons.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Panels, dialogs, menus, the dragged suggestion card.

shadows.name: shadow-contact
shadows.purpose: A garment cut-out standing on its card (filter, follows the silhouette).

shadows.name: glass-edge
shadows.purpose: The lit top edge every raised surface carries next to its shadow.

shadows.name: glass-dark-edge
shadows.purpose: The lit edge of dark glass chrome.

shadows.name: ring-focus
shadows.purpose: Field focus halo, together with an accent-warm border.

glass.name: glass-card
glass.purpose: Card level: translucent warm fill without backdrop-filter (grid cards, hot cards, picker tiles).

glass.name: glass-chrome
glass.purpose: Chrome level: the desktop top bar, on a pseudo-element.

glass.name: glass-blur-panel
glass.purpose: Frosted overlays inside a panel and on-media buttons.

glass.name: glass-blur-sm
glass.purpose: Light frost: popover backdrops, the modeled-hero fade, processing bands.

glass.name: glass-dark
glass.purpose: Dark chrome level: phone bottom nav and floating secondary actions; refraction from GlassFilter.jsx.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for anything arriving or changing state.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Slight overshoot for something settling after being moved (suggestion deck).

motion.name: dur-pop
motion.purpose: Hover, colour and small state changes.

breakpoints.name: narrow-phone

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; width: 200px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: zoom-in; font-family: 'Instrument Sans Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card__art { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: .84; margin-bottom: 9px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .5); border-radius: var(--r-lg, 20px); background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255, 252, 246, .92), rgba(246, 237, 224, .84)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .7), var(--shadow-sm); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), box-shadow 260ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-card__art svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(60, 47, 33, .12)) drop-shadow(0 8px 12px rgba(60, 47, 33, .16)); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card__art { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .7), var(--shadow-md); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-card:focus-visible .ds-card__art { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-warm, #8c4436); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card__name { color: var(--ink-soft, #2e2a26); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card__type { color: var(--muted, #6d675f); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card__type em { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent-warm, #8c4436); }

components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 360px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .5); border-radius: var(--r-xl, 28px); background: var(--paper-warm, #f7f2e9); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .7), var(--shadow-lg); overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Instrument Sans Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-soft, #2e2a26); } .ds-panel__head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 24px 10px 34px; } .ds-panel__head h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #191919); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.025em; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-panel__close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #2e2a26); cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel__close:hover { background: rgba(46, 42, 38, .045); } .ds-panel__close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-warm, #8c4436); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-panel__body { padding: 8px 34px 24px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-panel__foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 34px 16px; } .ds-panel__danger { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b23a2a 36%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #b23a2a; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel__primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #6e302e); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #6e302e); color: var(--paper, #f4f0e8); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel__primary:hover { background: var(--accent-warm, #8c4436); }

narrative.overview:
Wardrobe is a quiet workroom for the clothes someone already owns. Everything around the garments is warm paper: a cream field lit by three soft radial pools and a barely visible grain, so that backdrop-filter has something real to blur. The garments are the only saturated things on screen; the interface keeps to ink, muted taupe and one oxblood accent that marks the single action a view is for.

Depth is material rather than decorative. Cards are translucent warm fills with a lit top edge and a warm, soft shadow; chrome that content scrolls under is real frosted glass; floating controls on a phone switch to a dark, refracting glass register so the colour passing underneath becomes the thing you see. Panels and dialogs are opaque paper with the largest radius in the set, sitting on a lightly blurred scrim. Motion is short, exponential, and grows from the thing that was touched.

The surface mode is Operate: the user is in a task (find a piece, build an outfit, decide what to keep), so consistency and scanability outrank expression, and the brand lives in the precise details: the warm shadow tint, the lit edge, the contact shadow under a cut-out.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals only; nothing pure black on pure white. `--ink-soft` carries body copy, `--ink` is for emphasis and filled surfaces.
One accent (oxblood) for the one primary action, selection rings and accent ink; never decoration.
Glass in four registers (card fill, light chrome, panel, dark chrome), each with its own blur budget.
Generous, consistent rounding: five radius steps plus pill.
One sans family (Instrument Sans Variable) carrying every role; levels differ by size, headings are all weight 500.
Short, purposeful motion (140 / 180 / 260 ms) with custom ease-out curves; every effect has a reduced-motion and reduced-transparency fallback.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Oxblood fills at most one control per section; a second filled button in the same view is a bug, not emphasis. (The global top bar counts as its own section.)

rules.name: The Garments Are the Colour Rule
rules.body: No new brand colours, gradients or tinted panels. Hue on screen comes from photos, cut-outs and the season palette swatches. (Binding for this UI round: `docs/impeccable/plan.md`.)

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted `rgba(60, 47, 33, …)`; a cool grey shadow on cream reads as dirt.

rules.name: The Six Sizes Rule
rules.body: Every `font-size` is a `--text-*` token; no hand-set px values. Levels differ by size, not weight: every heading is 500, 600 is for emphasis inside body text and short labels.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing smaller than 11px except the two documented exceptions.

rules.name: The Blur Budget Rule
rules.body: Blur radius is a performance budget, not a style knob: 20px only on the desktop chrome, 14px on panel overlays, 10px with no saturate on anything floating over scrolling content on a phone, 3px on the full-viewport scrim. Never add a new blur value.

rules.name: The Lit Edge Rule
rules.body: Anything raised carries `--glass-edge` alongside its shadow; anything glass carries `--glass-border`.

rules.name: The Five Radii Rule
rules.body: Every rectangular surface picks one of the five steps; nothing invents its own (three hand-set radii remain, listed as orphans).

dos: **Do** take every colour from the `:root` tokens; add no new brand colour.
**Do** use `--r-*` for every corner, `--shadow-*` for every shadow, `--glass-blur*` for every blur and `--s-*` for spacing that lands on the scale.
**Do** use the button classes from `buttons.css` and re-theme them only through `--btn-*`.
**Do** keep one filled oxblood action per section and put it last in its row.
**Do** build every modal on `ViewerPanel`'s header / body / footer anatomy.
**Do** give every raised surface `--glass-edge` and every garment a contact shadow.
**Do** provide `prefers-reduced-motion` and `prefers-reduced-transparency` fallbacks for every new effect.
donts: **Don't** set a `font-size` outside the `--text-*` scale or below 11px.
**Don't** add backdrop-filter to grid cards, or a blur radius outside the five `--glass-blur*` tokens.
**Don't** use cool grey or black shadows, or a zero-offset coloured glow outside the AI moments that already have one.
**Don't** put a second filled primary in a view, or make a destructive action filled except at its final confirmation.
**Don't** add a top-level nav destination for a secondary feature; it belongs in a hot card or a panel.
**Don't** stack an uppercase eyebrow above a title that already names the thing (see `docs/impeccable/audit.md`).
